title: Reading CSV, Excel, JSON, Parquet and SQL

videos.script: Data arrives in five shapes. A CSV. A spreadsheet. JSON from a web service. A Parquet file from another team. A database. {{five}} pandas reads them all with one line each. {{one}} What differs is what each one remembers about the data. {{remember}} A CSV remembers nothing. Every value is text, and pandas guesses. {{csv}} Save the weather the way a spreadsheet in Recife saves it, with semicolons and decimal commas. Read it back the English way. {{br}} No error. One column, and the decimals turned into an index. {{wrong}} JSON decides some types by itself, from the column's name. Parquet keeps every type, in a file under half the size. {{parquet}} And a database can do the counting before anything reaches Python. {{sql}} By the end you will know, for each format, what to tell pandas, and what to check after it obeys. {{end}}
